title: Catch record
description: One record per event where a defect was caught before it shipped. The file is JSON Lines: one of these objects per line, no wrapping array. The class enum is derived from the recorded events, not invented up front — add a value only when a real event does not fit an existing one, and say so in the README's class table.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the file. Never reused or renumbered.

date.description: The date the catch happened, UTC. For a catch attributed to a merged PR this is the UTC date of mergedAt, which can be the day after the local evening the work happened.

repo.description: Repository the defect lived in — not necessarily the one that caught it.

class.description: How the defect hid. Derived from the events in this file; see the README's class table for the count behind each value.

detector.description: What actually found it, named specifically: a gate command, a review lens, a probe, or `human`. `unknown` is permitted only with confidence `low` and `detector` listed in `unverified`.

detector_kind.description: gate = an automated check that failed on its own. review-lens = a deliberate independent pass (report-only review, verifier, fault injection, red-team). human = a person or agent noticing while reading or probing, outside a scheduled lens.

caught_by_machine.description: true only when an automated check went red unprompted and that failure is what surfaced the defect. A fault injection that came back GREEN is false by construction — the finding is the silence.

summary.description: What the defect was and why it hid, concretely enough that a reader who never saw the change can judge it.

evidence_ref.description: Where to go and look: `repo@sha`, `path:line`, an issue or PR number, or a retained bundle path. Must resolve to something a reader can open.

fix_ref.description: The commit, file, or practice that closed it. null means genuinely unfixed — explain in notes.

confidence.description: How well grounded the row is. `low` rows are excluded from the machine/human ratio and must list what is unverified.

unverified.description: Field names that could not be grounded in something read. Empty for a fully verified row.

notes.description: Corrections, caveats, and anything a reader would otherwise have to rediscover.
